title: Document amount on Purchase Invoice Header
summary: Business Central 2025 wave 1 adds a feature to compare document-level totals with line-level amounts on purchase invoices, preventing posting discrepancies and ensuring data accuracy. The feature requires setup in Purchases & Payables and validates that header amounts match line totals, including VAT considerations.
key_points: Feature compares Doc. Amount Incl. Tax field against sum of tax amounts on purchase lines during posting
Must be enabled in Purchases & Payables Setup before fields appear on purchase invoices
Users enter total amount in Doc. Amount Incl. Tax field; Doc. Amount Tax auto-calculates from lines
Posting fails with error if amounts don't match, preventing incorrect document entries
VAT Difference allowance setting is factored into the validation logic
